Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning

Class NodalAnalysis

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning.NodalAnalysis
public class NodalAnalysis extends Object
Nodal (inflow times outflow) analysis at the bottom-hole node with stability classification and sensitivity sweeps.

The inflow curve gives the available flowing bottom-hole pressure as a function of rate (decreasing with rate) and the outflow curve the required bottom-hole pressure for a given wellhead pressure (tubing performance, often U-shaped in gas wells with liquid loading). The rate range is scanned for sign changes of inflow minus outflow and every intersection is refined by bisection. An intersection is stable when the outflow curve rises faster with rate than the inflow curve (the net slope of inflow minus outflow is negative); the highest-rate stable intersection is the operating point. Rates may be in any consistent unit (for example Sm3/day or kg/s).

Ready adapters: linear productivity index, Vogel, tabulated curves, the gas-condensate inflow model and the drift-flux wellbore hydraulics. Sensitivities on tubing size, wellhead pressure, skin, GOR, water cut or depletion are run by supplying a factory that builds the inflow or outflow curve for each parameter value.

Limitations: single-node (bottom hole), one well, no choke or network back-pressure coupling (use the existing WellSystem or production-network classes for that). Validation is by closed-form intersections of linear and Vogel curves.
